threejs_runtime_notes: Three.js GLTFLoader sanitizes node and bone names using THREE.PropertyBinding.sanitizeNodeName() (e.g. 'handslot.r' -> 'handslotr', 'Shoulder.L' -> 'ShoulderL', 'Bip01 Pelvis' -> 'Bip01_Pelvis'). Always resolve bone names or pass SkeletonUtils.retargetClip bone maps through sanitizeNodeName().

When disposing loaded SkinnedMesh characters, explicitly call obj.skeleton.dispose() alongside geometry, material, and material texture disposal; omitting skeleton.dispose() leaks one GPU boneTexture per SkinnedMesh reload cycle (empirically verified in Chromium/WebGL2).

rocketbox-bip01.authoring_convention: 3ds Max Biped Z-up authored in centimeters beneath a 0.01 scale 'Bip01' root transform node.
rocketbox-bip01.direct_clip_sharing: Compatible within microsoft-rocketbox family (matching Bip01 naming). Not directly compatible with KayKit or Quaternius rigs.

kaykit-rig-medium.mannequin_exception: Mannequin_Medium.glb has 21 skin joints (omits handslot.l and handslot.r; track filtering drops those 2 nodes cleanly).
kaykit-rig-medium.authoring_convention: Y-up meters, stylized humanoid proportions, lower-case dot-suffixed limbs (.l / .r) + handslot.l / handslot.r.
kaykit-rig-medium.direct_clip_sharing: 100% directly shareable via AnimationMixer across all KayKit Adventurers, KayKit Skeletons, Mannequin_Medium, and all 8 Rig_Medium GLB packs (131 non-T-Pose clips).

kaykit-rig-large.authoring_convention: Y-up meters, heavy/bulky proportions matching Rig_Large animations.
kaykit-rig-large.direct_clip_sharing: Directly shareable within Rig_Large (28 non-T-Pose clips + Mannequin_Large). Visually distinct translation offsets/proportions from Rig_Medium; do not blindly share Rig_Medium position tracks onto Rig_Large without bone-proportion verification.

quaternius-universal-65.authoring_convention: Unreal Engine Mannequin naming convention (root, pelvis, spine_01..03, neck_01, Head, clavicle_l/r, upperarm_l/r, lowerarm_l/r, hand_l/r, 5-finger leaf chains, thigh_l/r, calf_l/r, foot_l/r, ball_l/r).
quaternius-universal-65.direct_clip_sharing: 100% bit-exact 65-joint set identity across UBC Standard bases, UBC rigged hairstyles, Fantasy Outfits + all 20 modular parts, UAL1 Standard (43 clips), UAL2 Standard (43 clips), and Mannequin_F.
modular_assembly_rules: Modular Fantasy Outfits (4 outfits, 20 parts) share identical 65-bone hierarchies and bind poses; bind a per-part AnimationMixer fed with the same filtered clip (or clone/rebind skeletons).
Per Quaternius Readme.txt, pair only the head of Universal Base Characters with full outfits to avoid skin poking through sleeves/torsos.
UBC Hairstyles in 'Rigged to Head Bone' share the 65-bone rig; 'Origin at 0' hairstyles require parenting directly to the Head bone.

quaternius-umw-62.authoring_convention: Blender armature with IK foot/pole-target controls (Foot.L/R and PT.L/R parented to Root instead of LowerLeg.L/R).
quaternius-umw-62.direct_clip_sharing: All 10 UMW characters, 41 modular FBX->GLB parts, and UMW_Animations.glb (24 clips) share the exact 62-bone rig.
quaternius-umw-62.retargeting_warning: Rotation-only Three.js SkeletonUtils.retargetClip from FK-foot rigs (UAL1/UAL2) leaves Foot.L and Foot.R anchored at Root origin while legs bend, visibly stretching calves/boots (observed in Chromium QA case 15_retarget_ual1_to_umw_adventurer). Treat UMW as incompatible with FK rotation-only retargeting unless converted to FK feet or driving foot IK targets.

quaternius-rpg-32.authoring_convention: Stylized RPG Blender armature with embedded Weapon.R and IK/PoleTarget.L/R bones; self-contained class clips (11-15 per character).
quaternius-rpg-32.direct_clip_sharing: Each RPG character ships its own tailored animation set (11-15 clips). Not directly plug-compatible with UAL1/UAL2 or UMW due to distinct joint count (32) and Foot/PoleTarget hierarchy.

retargeting_workflows.verified_in_chromium: 17_retarget_ual1_to_kaykit_knight (Visual inspection confirmed clean Jog_Fwd_Loop leg/arm stride without mesh twist or clipping).
retargeting_workflows.method: SkeletonUtils.retargetClip with explicit UAL_TO_KAYKIT bone map, computed bind-pose world rotation offsets (R_src^-1 * R_dst), preservePosition=false, and strip '.position' tracks (rotation-only retarget preserves stylized KayKit limb proportions).

retargeting_workflows.verified_in_chromium: 16_retarget_ual1_to_rocketbox_male01 (Legs/torso/head stride cleanly; minor left-forearm inward tuck noted from Bip01 rest-pose roll / A-to-T pose offset).
retargeting_workflows.method: SkeletonUtils.retargetClip with UAL_TO_ROCKETBOX map, computed rest-pose localOffsets, strip '.position' tracks, AND restore target bone scales after retargetClip so Bip01's 0.01 parent scale does not leave 100x scale matrices on child bones.

retargeting_workflows.verified_in_chromium: 15_retarget_ual1_to_umw_adventurer (Visual inspection showed detached IK Foot.L/R remaining anchored at floor origin while legs moved, stretching boots vertically).
retargeting_workflows.recommendation: Use the 24 native UMW clips included in Individual Characters/*.glb and UMW_Animations.glb, or bake FK foot hierarchy in Blender before retargeting.

incompatible_pairs_explicit.reason: Completely disjoint bone counts (23 vs 65), naming (.l/.r vs UE _l/_r), and rest proportions; requires explicit rotation-only retargeting.
Translation curves in Rig_Large are scaled for larger proportions; keep clips paired to their own Rig_Medium / Rig_Large family unless retargeted.
3ds Max cm Biped (80-81 bones) vs Blender 32-bone IK rig.
Distinct joint counts (62 vs 32) and distinct rig layouts.
